answer: In an AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing digital identity verification via blockchain-based notarization can mitigate fake-identity attacks. This mechanism works by requiring agents to prove their identity through a decentralized, publicly verifiable process, akin to riding the tide of a secure network. Each agent's digital identity is then linked to a unique, cryptographically secure "ocean" of public keys, ensuring that an attacker attempting to create multiple identities would be unable to escape the vault of secure verification, ultimately exposing their fake identities.
